gloss: last working day of the year (government offices)

definitions.gloss: last working day of the year in government offices
definitions.explanation: The last day of work before the New Year holiday in national and local government offices, normally December 28 (the weekday before, if the 28th falls on a weekend), since the year-end holiday runs from December 29 to January 3. Its counterpart is {御用始|ごようはじ}め, the first working day of the new year (normally January 4).

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{御用納|ごようおさ}めだ。
examples.english: Today is the last working day of the year for government offices.

examples.japanese: {御用納|ごようおさ}め⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{普通|ふつう}→普通：01502_futsuu⟧⟦{十二月|じゅうにがつ}→十二月：00636_juunigatsu⟧{二十八日|にじゅうはちにち}だ。
examples.english: Government offices usually close for the year on December 28.

examples.japanese: ⟦{市役所|しやくしょ}→市役所：03067_shiyakusho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{窓口|まどぐち}→窓口：03154_madoguchi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{御用納|ごようおさ}め⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{年明|としあ}け→年明け：12476_toshiake⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{休|やす}み→休み：02266_yasumi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The city hall counters close from the last working day of the year until the new year.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{御用|ごよう}→御用：12848_goyou⟧ (official business) + {納|おさ}め (finishing). Used of government offices; companies and ordinary workplaces say ⟦{仕事納|しごとおさ}め→仕事納め：16213_shigotoosame⟧, though the two are often used loosely for each other.

RELATED WORDS:
- {御用始|ごようはじ}め: the first working day of the year (January 4)
- ⟦{仕事納|しごとおさ}め→仕事納め：16213_shigotoosame⟧: the last working day of the year (general)
- ⟦{仕事始|しごとはじ}め→仕事始め：32432_shigotohajime⟧: the first working day of the year (general)
